paragraphs: SmartCover sells remote monitoring and controls for sewer, lift stations and stormwater infrastructure. The company describes the offering as turning real-time remote infrastructure data into insights for utility customers who want to minimize OpEx and reduce CapEx. Stated uses include overflow prevention, cleaning schedules, I&I identification, and chemical optimization.

The pages present satellite communication as what keeps the system visible. Alarms and notifications are described as giving advance notice so staff can prepare and respond. Installation is described as needing no confined space entry, with the work done in shop. A mobile app is offered, with system insights available wherever the user is.

A published case study covers the City of Kelowna in British Columbia. That city is described as using the technology for overflow prevention, optimization of high frequency cleaning, and ongoing I&I studies. Other departments in the city are described as using it for H2S monitoring, leachate at the solid waste facility, and stream level monitoring.

quote.text: Uninterrupted visibility of the system reduces risks, avoids damages and fees, and encourages efficiencies.
